AccessProjectionEventContent.title: AccessProjectionEventContent
AccessProjectionEventContent.description: Immutable content of one access-projection lifecycle event (the W010 event shape): stream, sequence, tenant scope, principal actor, causal parent, namespaced payload, and the producer-supplied occurrence instant.

AccessStreamId.title: AccessStreamId
AccessStreamId.description: One access-projection event stream id (the W010 grammar): stream:access-<slug>, one object/policy/tenant-state = one stream.

AccessProjectionEventSequence.title: AccessProjectionEventSequence
AccessProjectionEventSequence.description: One access-projection event sequence number: 1-based, contiguous per access-projection stream.

TenantId.title: TenantId
TenantId.description: Opaque tenant identity: "tenant:" followed by a lowercase slug.

AccessPrincipalId.title: AccessPrincipalId
AccessPrincipalId.description: One principal id inside access-projection records (the W009 identity grammar).

AccessProjectionCausalParent.title: AccessProjectionCausalParent
AccessProjectionCausalParent.description: Causal parent of an access-projection event: an earlier event in the same stream (the W010 shape).

AccessProjectionEventPayload.title: AccessProjectionEventPayload
AccessProjectionEventPayload.description: Typed event payload of an access-projection event: namespaced discriminator plus opaque JSON data (the W010 shape).

Timestamp.title: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: UTC instant in canonical form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ (exactly three fractional digits, Z suffix).
